output_list.reason: The mintToken function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The initialSupply is multiplied by 10^uint256(decimals), which can overflow if initialSupply is large enough. This can be exploited to increase the balance of the owner to a very large amount.

The _transfer function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The function does not check if the balanceOf[_to] + _value is greater than balanceOf[_to], which can overflow if balanceOf[_to] is large enough.

output_list.vulnerability: The burnFrom function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The function does not check if balanceOf[_from] is greater than _value, which can overflow if balanceOf[_from] is large enough.
